title: The first ninety days: asking questions, the first commit, the first mistake

videos.script: You got the job. Now there is a desk, an account that does not work yet, and forty people whose names you will forget by lunch. {{desk}} The first three months are the ones people remember you by, and nobody gives you a plan for them. {{remember}} Most juniors try to prove themselves fast: say yes to everything, ask nothing, fix something big in the first week. It usually goes the other way. {{fast}} This lesson gives the ninety days a rough shape, and deals with the three moments that matter most: asking questions, the first thing you ship, and the first mistake.
